result.summary: Sub-step F2 of section 12 is built only by the code design that passed its gate (step 01f; design sha256 469b32af…56d6). app/content/sai-intake.json is Sai's own intake in the format sai-picker-tenant/2 (decisions/0123 О7) with its ru texts: id sai-intake; five questions, each single, required false, no show_if, no help — «Для чего вам нужен сайт или приложение?» (4 options), «Кто будет им пользоваться?» (2), «Что в нём важнее всего?» (4), «Сколько в нём будет страниц?» (2), «Нужно ли сохранять данные между посещениями?» (3: not needed, on this device, on all devices) — the working proposal of 4.9 in its final wording; the six solutions landing «Лендинг», card-site «Сайт-визитка или портфолио», catalog «Каталог», calculator «Калькулятор», dashboard «Панель показателей», single-page-app «Одностраничное приложение», in this order, one per kind of PLAN §2, each with a summary, 4 includes, 1 needs_from_you, 1 next step and 2 not_suitable_when texts, no price_text, duration_text, leads or hypotheses; 35 rules of one condition each (29 with 1 to 4 points, and six of −10 points on «Да, на всех устройствах», one per solution, so data for every device, which needs a server, gives the honest no match); result top 3, min_score 3, clear_lead_gap 2 and the no_match_text «По этим ответам Sai пока не может собрать подходящий продукт. Например, данные для всех устройств хранятся на сервере, а серверы Sai пока не делает.». Every text for the visitor is an object with its ru value only (118 texts); kk comes by F2k and en by F2e, so until F2e the picker check lists exactly the 236 missing translations, as row F2 says («→ 0 (after F2e)»). The ru names of landing, catalog and calculator equal order_example_1_kind, _2_kind and _3_kind of the texts module (4.1). app/content/sai-intake.answers/ holds the seven fixtures, each the answers object itself: landing, card-site, catalog, calculator, dashboard and single-page-app each answer all five questions and make their solution the first (each a clear leader), and server-needed (a team app with records on all devices) gives no match. Checks: the row's driver outside the project passes 4662 checks (4.9, the format /2 check, the text rules, the ru lists Г, Б, В, П, Ц, С and ₸, the word ban and the phrases on every string, no «заказ» stem, every one of the 900 combinations through the byte copy with parity to the original engine: 238 no match — 225 of them with «Да, на всех устройствах» — and every solution first in 67 to 152 combinations; five «Не знаю» give no match) and is red on 21 damaged copies; the scripts of REQ-111 criterion 10 find none of the 29 names, 11 phone numbers and 150 kk draft strings of the sample in the files; the budgets of look 13.3 hold in headless Chrome 157 on macOS (question h2 two lines at 390, option labels two lines at 390 and at 1470, no word cut at 320 in any slot of the intake); the static part is clean; the full app check on a fresh clone of base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build with only these eight files exits 0 (unit 46 of 46, int 36 of 36); in the shared tree only IB-1 is red, by row B1's declaration file, the same line without and with these files (issue I1); traces 0. Red after it: none, as row F2 says. Glossary of the ru terms of the intake, for F2k and F2e: «сайт или приложение» — what the visitor needs, named in question 1 and then by «им», «в нём»; «Лендинг» — a one-page site (= order_example_1_kind: kk «Лендинг», en «Landing page»); «Сайт-визитка или портфолио» — a business-card or portfolio site (order_can_2); «Каталог» (= order_example_2_kind: kk «Каталог», en «Catalog»); «Калькулятор» (= order_example_3_kind: kk «Калькулятор», en «Calculator»), whose summary also covers a test or a form (order_can_4); «Панель показателей» — a simple dashboard on sample data (order_can_5); «Одностраничное приложение» — a small single-page app (order_can_6); «примерные данные» — sample data; «на этом устройстве» — kept in this browser; «на всех устройствах» — data for every device, which needs a server; «серверы Sai пока не делает» — as nobuild_1; «учётная программа», «учётная система или CRM» — outside accounting systems (nobuild_5); «Описать идею простыми словами» — the next step, the wording of describe_idea; the polite «вы» form throughout.
